newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Kopran ties up with UK drug firm.
newsitem.headline: India's Kopran ties up with UK drug firm.

text.p: Indian pharmaceuticals maker Kopran Ltd said it entered into an agreement with DDSA of U.K. to manufacture pharmaceutical products for the U.K. market.
The products would be marketed under DDSA name. DDSA is one of the oldest generic houses of U.K., a Kopran statement said.
"The above arrangement will ensure a minimum sales of $1.0 million in the first year itself which is likely to grow substantially with the introduction of newer products," it said.

"Kopran's export of formulations was a mere 120 million rupees for the year 1995/96 (April-March) and is expected to increase to one billion rupees in the next three years for which various registrations are being put in place," it said.
Kopran is a leading manufacturer of semi-synthetic penicillins used in antibiotic medicines.
